name: muse-double-blink-to-modulation
description: Logical dependencies. Actual path ownership is confirmed against the live repo in node 00; the write_scope lists below are the proposed freeze.

execution_rules.parallelism: 01 with 02 after 00; 05 and 06 with 03 and 04 once the seam is frozen. Parallelize only with the confirmed disjoint write scopes above.
single_writer: modules/muse/runtime/ belongs to 01; node 06 writes only dispatch.py within it
apps/web shared shell (src/main.tsx, style.css) belongs to the music pack node 06; this pack sends scoped requests via docs/requests/
the live headset capture process and any bridge socket
contracts/0.1/ and root locks belong to the integrator and to no node
any final-test split, which is immutable once claimed via FinalTestLock
execution_rules.cross_pack_rule: This pack constructs and dispatches ControlAction. The music pack validates, schedules and sounds it. Neither re-derives the other's fields; neither chooses signed_semitones.
execution_rules.repair_policy: Route the smallest repair to its owning node and rerun affected downstream gates. Repairs are tracked iterations, not new DAG edges.
execution_rules.completion: All mandatory checks in node 07 passed on the exact demo path. Otherwise deliver a truthful failed, blocked or unverified status with a precise blocker and a replay demo that is not described as hardware-validated.
